suites.title: B5 Production Runtime Lifecycle Foundation - Adversarial & Invariant Tests

specs.title: 1. Enter -> repeated Enter: rapid enter requests never create duplicate canvas or renderer
2. Enter -> Skip -> late load completion: Skip settles instantly to HOME; late tasks cannot corrupt state
3. Enter -> Escape: pressing Escape during entrance skips directly to HOME
4. Enter -> route navigation: navigating to portfolio routes cancels world and unmounts canvas cleanly
5. Enter -> Back: browser back button returns to clean static portfolio without errors
6. loading -> renderer failure: simulated renderer failure gracefully renders accessible fallback
7. failed asset -> Retry: simulated asset failure shows bounded retry
8. failure -> Continue with portfolio: dismisses fallback and returns to clean portfolio
9. reduced-motion enabled before entry: bypasses camera travel directly to HOME
10. reduced-motion toggled during active experience: updates camera transition travel
11. PROVE: single owners verified across all domains
12. PROVE: semantic navigation survives renderer failure
